# Map tiles: OpenStreetMap's own tile server does not allow commercial use.
# OpenFreeMap (free, no key, commercial use allowed) serves vector tiles,
# drawn by MapLibre under the existing Leaflet map; the RTL plugin shapes Hebrew labels.
install maplibre-gl@^5 @maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet@^0.1 @mapbox/mapbox-gl-rtl-text@^0.3 -w apps/web
